title: Nope, Funko boxes have been declining in quality
text: I always had looked forward to the boxes every other month. But not any more after opening this one I am highly disappointed and dissatisfied with my purchase. 3 collectible items cool, I always wanted a keychain and a mystery mini and a pop. It was always so much cooler when you still got something to wear with that. I understand you still need to make a profit but come on, 30$ for a jumbo pop? I could go to thinkgeek and buy 3 pops I always wanted for the same price and GET one more for free. I will be unsubscribing from all of the subscriptions as this isn't worth it to me any more.
label: negative
